t: This is Woburn Place, a street in Camden. It's part of the A4200, a major route through central London that runs from Aldwych up through Holborn, Bloomsbury, Euston and Somers Town to Mornington Crescent. Robert Waithman died here in 1833. He started out as a master draper, became a progressive Whig and a reformer, and rose to be an alderman of the City Corporation, which elected him Lord Mayor of London for a ceremonial year.
